title: Lectine Pathway in Unstable Carotid Plaque
brief_summary: The study is aimed to investigate the possible role of lectin pathway - an alternative pathway of complement activation - in affecting stability of carotid atherosclerotic plaques and the possible correlations with clinical neurologic features.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients undergone elective or urgent carotid endoarterectomy (CEA) for internal carotid stenosis \>70% (assessed by velocimetric criteria) with or without neurologic symptoms

Exclusion Criteria:

* recent (\<20 days) major/minor stroke with positive CT scan
* absolute contraindications to surgery (cardiac, respiratory, anesthesiologic risk)
study_population: Study population will include 40 patients with symptomatic or asymptomatic internal carotid artery stenosis \>=70% (measured by echocolordoppler) treated by elective or urgent endoarterectomy.
